name: Italian Heritage
notes: Reusable heritage theme built from source-frame.webp (diffui Option A, chromolithograph on charcoal). Same fixed window+plaque template as ancestor-card. Maps are relief-aware: the printed corner vignettes are held to the paper plane (high-pass) so they do not crater, while the gold ornament rides a raised plateau and keeps its groove relief. Rebuild: npm run build:theme-frame -- italian-heritage (or node scripts/build-theme-frame.js italian-heritage).
